blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Megastar Sharon Cuneta and her daughter, Frankie “Kakie” Pangilinan, attended the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte at the Senate on Monday, the 38th day of the proceedings. Cuneta, the wife of Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan, was spotted at the Senate gallery alongside their daughter, Kakie. After his interpellation of the prosecution’s final witness, forensic expert Alexander Cabrera, Pangilinan exchanged glances with Cuneta, prompting the singer-actress to smile. Pangilinan shared a video of the moment set to Maria Deborah’s Na Para Bang trending audio with the lyrics, “Sabi ko sarili ko wala lang ’to, pero ba’t sa’yo […]...
